title: The flying fish tram
alt: A blue fish-shaped tram floats above green roof gardens and bridges in a canal city.
description: A fantastical mechanical vehicle with articulated fins, passenger windows and richly layered urban surroundings.
prompt: An elaborate original animated-film concept illustration of a small tram designed like a fantastical blue flying fish, floating above a lush canal city. One streamlined metal fish-shaped body contains coherent rectangular passenger windows; two translucent fin-shaped wings attach at the sides, a single fan-like tail is connected at the rear, and a rounded head has a small forward headlamp. Decorative brass rivets, city bridges, terraces and hanging gardens create rich layered detail. Complete vehicle visible, clear connected mechanical design, no passengers or lettering.
